title: Bring back every must-learn item
statement: Check that every item marked must-learn comes back for retrieval from memory in a later lesson, since a unit plan can leave whole lessons' must-learn items never recalled.
example: In one unit, only one of the three lessons whose retrieval recalls the previous lesson asks for a key line from memory.
detail: A design note for a 3D version audited the unit's knowledge base and found that of the three lessons whose retrieval recalls the previous lesson, only one asks for a key line from memory, so the must-learn lines of two lessons are never brought back from memory and by the last lesson's closing tasks students must find quotes again rather than recall them. The knowledge base's retrieval column holds a single quote-analysis row for the unit. The note calls retrieval of exact wording the one thing a closing essay needs and the knowledge base leaves to chance.
against: The fix it proposes, one finish-the-line row in each later lesson's retrieval, was never built (`othello-archive/design-notes/spaced-quote-recall.md`, line 3, "Status: proposal only. Nothing built.").
